name: 8 Coil Shakti two-phase: hippocampus both sides, then amygdala left
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: One of Todd Murphy's 'as seen on TV' two-phase sessions for the 8 Coil Shakti: the hippocampal signal over both temporal lobes for 20 min, then the amygdala signal over the left temporal lobe for 20 min. Murphy states that the amygdala signal on the left in phase 2 gives emotional or positive after-effects. Both signals are rebuilt from descriptions.
notes: The vendor's page lists the hippocampal signal on both sides, then the amygdala signal on the left side only, with six coils on the left (four left-channel, two right-channel) and two right-channel coils on the right (output_1_bi_hipp__2_l_amy.htm). The 20 + 20 min rests on the demo video (captions at 2:34), not on the page. Phase 1 drives the two right-channel pairs (FTT7h, TTP9h on the left; FTT8h, TTP10h on the right), phase 2 the left-channel cross (FT7, C5, TP7, T9). Sites and polarity are this project's reading of the photos: TTP9h, TTP10h, C5 and FT7 are reversed. For this layout the vendor's video says all left coils are positive, as in murphy-shakti8-tv-chirpbi-amyl. The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length (230 points of 3 ms; Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592]); its point values were never published as numbers. Each is followed by 4 s of silence. Both stand in for unpublished vendor files. The vendor's 10 to 50 mG carries no distance (measurement.htm, duds.htm); an independent meter read 0.1 to 1.0 uT RMS about 9 cm from the coils (Gendle 2012 p.11 [227]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The effects are vendor claims. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). On headache or pressure, lower the intensity by one third. Anger or restlessness in phase 1: Skip or Stop. Anger or a 'racing mind' in phase 2: stop and do not use it again. Not for people prone to anger. Not for anyone with epilepsy, a psychiatric condition or medication, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs. Stop on fear or distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence ('not just quiet'), at night; eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark. The vendor: 'You don't have to use sensory deprivation if you're looking for after-effects.'
schedule: Vendor: while trying sessions out, at most every 72 h; once you settle on a session, once a week; never on consecutive days. For sessions of an hour or more (the 60-min run) the demo video and the safety pages say once every 3 weeks (one week if the session had no effect), but the vendor's 60-minute page exempts two-phase sessions from that rule.
